<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>养<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>繁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>茂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>严<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>严<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>做<ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>拙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuō</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>笨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèn</rt></ruby><ruby>舌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>肯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>亏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuī</rt></ruby><ruby>负<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>寄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>欺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>压<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>埃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Āi</rt></ruby><ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>寄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>寡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>孤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡū</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>；

“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>贫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pín</rt></ruby><ruby>穷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>借<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>钱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>债<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>取<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>令<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>清<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>筑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>支<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>派<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pài</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>洒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby>！<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>凭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>据<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby>。”

verses.text: “<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>初<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>桌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuō</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>搬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">she</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>搬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bān</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>香<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>柜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>挂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuà</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>帘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>燔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。
